Alert queue

All customers, names and transactions are synthetic and generated for this project. The planted cases make detection look easier than it is: real alert queues are far noisier and most alerts do not lead to a SAR. The SAR drafts are rule-based and fact-checked. An analyst decides whether to file, completes the marked blanks and is responsible for the final report.
